incident-bot: ALERT: realtime p95/p99 latency regression detected for hosted-api-prod (eu-west). p95 jumped to ~1.2s (+4x), p99 ~2.4s. Streaming stalls metric spiked. AlertID: A-20260317-4912345670 :rotating_light:
Alice (oncall): paging — I'm on it. pulling dashboards + traces now. tagging @Carla and @Ben for routing/kv-cache checks.
Ben (sre): on my way. any recent deploys?
Carla (runtime): rolled model-routing canary ~11m ago (route-priority change). small config tweak, no infra changes.
Alice (oncall): quick numbers from Grafana: p95 320ms -> 1.2s, p99 750ms -> 2.4s, streaming stall-rate +8% over baseline. error rate stable. throughput up ~5%.
Dmitri (prod-eng): if routing changed, could be a variant mismatch causing KV cache key divergence. can we check kvcache hit ratio?
Alice (oncall): running quick query: `sum(rate(kv_cache_hits[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_lookups[5m]))` -> 0.12 (was ~0.68 30m ago).
Ben (sre): whoa — cache hit collapsed. that explains tail latency. any recent model signature/key change in canary?
Carla (runtime): canary changed the prefix encoding for cache keys (shortened hash) — trying to validate now.
Liz (support): CS report: multiple customers in EU seeing streaming timeouts and UI spinner for chat sessions. reporting increased time-to-first-token.
SRE-Ops: recommend immediate traffic shift to fallback routing and re-enable prefix-preserving cache behavior.
Alice (oncall): mitigation options: A) revert routing canary (rollback) B) force cache warm with full re-keying C) shift traffic to model-variant with preserved keys. prefer quick traffic shift now as lowest risk.
Carla (runtime): executing traffic shift to fallback variant `model-v2-stable` (20% -> 100% over 2m) now. command: `./ops shift-route --service hosted-api-prod --from canary --to model-v2-stable --duration 2m`
Ben (sre): I'll watch p95/p99 and kvcache metrics, instrument traces for 5m window. linking trace: https://traces.redwood/trace/4912345670 (short-lived)
Alice (oncall): kvcache hit ratio climbing: 12% -> 55% within first 90s. p95 trending down to ~380ms, p99 to ~820ms. streaming stalls reducing.
Liz (support): notifying affected customers that we're mitigating and expecting recovery within 10m.
Dmitri (prod-eng): follow-up: we should add automated key-compat check in canary gating. opened ticket ENG-7261.
Carla (runtime): will revert the key-shortening change in canary branch and re-run canary with compatibility test.
SRE-Ops: adding runbook note: if kvcache hit ratio drops >30% after deploy, auto-shift to fallback.
Alice (oncall): initial triage complete — mitigation in progress and customer notices sent. monitoring for full recovery. will escalate to on-call lead if regresses. closing the active paging loop when stable. :white_check_mark:
